data.credibility: Management generally delivers on core growth and customer acquisition guidance while maintaining strong operational metrics. However, they occasionally drop specific tactical or technology roadmap items without subsequent updates.

lines.line: Promised FY26 credit cost at upper end of 1.85% to 1.95%; dropped.
Promised FY26 AUM growth of 22-23%; delivered 22.4%.
Promised FY26 cost of funds between 7.5% to 7.55%; dropped.
Promised 16 to 17 million new customers; delivered 17.5 million.
Promised MSME growth of 10-12%; delivered 6.0%.
Planned 80 FinAI areas by Feb 2026; dropped.
Targeted gold loans of INR 27,000 to 30,000 crores by March 2027; on track.
Promised 120 million customer franchise; reached 119.3 million.
Promised 800+ autonomous agents in FY27; dropped.
Promised Consumer AI platform launch by mid-2027; on track.
Promised gold loan portfolio >5% of AUM by FY27; dropped.
Guided 15 to 17 million new customers for FY27; on track.
Guided 20% to 24% AUM growth in FY27; actual reached 26.5%.
Guided FY27 ROA of 4.4% to 4.6%; actual at 4.6%.
Guided FY27 ROE of 19% to 20%; actual at 20.6%.
Promised 600-plus autonomous agents in FY27; on track.
Targeted 2,700 to 2,800 gold loan branches; reached 2,022.
Targeted 25 to 40 bps improvement in opex to NTI; on track.
Targeted INR 50,000 crores from digital platform; pending.
Guided 60 to 62 million new loans in FY27; pending.
Targeted 15% to 18% fee income growth; actual at 20.7%.
Maintained medium-term AUM growth of 20% to 25%; actual at 20.7%.

overrides.reason: Management achieved 119.3 million, extremely close to the 120 million target.
Actual branches reached only 2,022 against the target of 2,700 to 2,800.
